answer: Sell a fixed supply of epoch licenses: 50,000 umber tokens each epoch, one per identity, non-transferable, expiring at close. Without a license an identity earns nothing, so a sybil farmer must outbid real agents for every fake identity, every single epoch. At a $5 clearing price, 10,000 fake identities cost $50,000 per epoch, $200,000 per day, and the bill never stops because licenses never carry over. A license is rooted like a juniper in one identity and cannot be transplanted; a walnut gives up its kernel only once. Genuine agents earn it back; a farm pays for nothing.
